card.name: Linking words in overdose treatment sentences
card.fires_on: The small word after 'consists', 'consist', 'concentrate' or 'directed' (of, on, toward) in an overdose section, just before 'general supportive measures'.

modes.label: consists of
modes.description: The word 'of' after 'treatment of overdose ... consists/should consist'.
modes.example: Treatment of overdose with lapatinib tablets should consist<< of>> general supportive measures.

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: 'on' or 'toward' after 'concentrate' or 'directed' in overdose management sentences.
modes.example: Management of a REXULTI overdose should concentrate<< on>> supportive therapy, maintaining an adequate airway

card.writes: It pushes words about emergency care, such as emergency, ambulance and rescue treatment.
card.plain: It marks the point in an overdose section where the text is about to name supportive emergency care.
